metadata.description: Official plugin marketplace for Pappardelle — the TUI for multi-clauding without losing your marbles. Includes the Pappardelle plugin: skills for installing, updating, and configuring Pappardelle, and the hooks that connect Claude sessions to the TUI.

plugins.name: pappardelle
plugins.description: Install, update, configure, and monitor Pappardelle workspaces. Provides /init-pappardelle (interactive setup wizard), /update-pappardelle (update to latest version), /configure-pappardelle (interactive config editor), /sous-chef (kitchen-style workspace coordinator), /link-pr (record a PR/MR for the workspace), and pappardelle-agent (workspace context and commands for any agent in a space, loaded by a SessionStart hook), plus the hooks that report Claude status to the TUI, post question answers to the issue, and send ntfy notifications.
